title: समकालीन नेपाली गजलमा बिम्ब [Images in the Contemporary Nepali Gajals]
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख समकालीन नेपाली गजलमा प्रयोग भएका प्रमुख बिम्बहरूको खोजी गर्ने उद्देश्यले तयार पारिएको हो । यसमा वि.सं. २०३६ सालदेखि हालसम्मको नेपाली गजलयात्रालाई समकालीन नेपाली गजल मानिएको छ । गुणात्मक ढाँचामा संरचित यस लेखमा सोद्देश्यमूलक नमुना छनौट विधि र दस्तावेज विश्लेषण गरेर तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । बिम्बहरूको छनौटको सैद्धान्तिक आधार बिम्बलाई बनाइएको छ । यस लेखमा उल्लिखित बिम्बहरू प्रायः आजका सबैजसो गजलकारका रचनाहरूमा भेटिन्छन् । यस अवधिका गजलमा दृश्यबिम्ब, स्वादबिम्ब, गन्धबिम्ब, ध्वनिबिम्ब, स्पर्शबिम्ब र गतिबिम्ब गरी ६ प्रकारका बिम्बहरू प्रयोग भएका छन् । यसरी बिम्ब प्रयोग समकालीन नेपाली गजलको एउटा महत्त्वपूर्ण प्राप्ति र विशेषता दुबै बनेको छ । यस लेखमा बिम्ब प्रयोग भएका केही गजलहरूको विश्लेषणबाट समकालीन नेपाली गजलमा बिम्बहरूको प्रयोगमा विविधता रहेको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: This article has been prepared with the objective of exploring the major imagery used in contemporary Nepali ghazals. In this, the journey of Nepali ghazals from 2036 BS to the present has been considered contemporary Nepali ghazal. Structured within a qualitative framework, data for this article were collected through purposive sampling and document analysis. Imagery itself has been made the theoretical foundation for the selection of images. The images mentioned in this article are found in the works of nearly all ghazal writers today. In the ghazals of this period, six types of images have been used, namely visual imagery, gustatory imagery, olfactory imagery, auditory imagery, tactile imagery, and kinesthetic imagery. Thus, the use of imagery has become both a significant achievement and a defining feature of contemporary Nepali ghazals. From the analysis of selected ghazals where imagery is used, the conclusion is drawn in this article that diversity exists in the use of images in contemporary Nepali ghazals.

informal_english: This article was put together to check out the main imagery used in contemporary Nepali ghazals. Here, the journey of Nepali ghazals from 2036 BS right up to now is taken as contemporary Nepali ghazal. Set up in a qualitative framework, data for this paper was collected using purposive sampling alongside document analysis. Imagery itself was used as the theoretical basis for picking out the images. The images brought up in this paper pop up across the work of pretty much every ghazal writer today. Ghazals from this era use six kinds of imagery: visual, gustatory, olfactory, auditory, tactile, and kinesthetic. In this way, using imagery has turned into both a major milestone and a signature feature of contemporary Nepali ghazals. Looking at a bunch of ghazals that use imagery, this paper wraps up with the finding that there is plenty of variety in how contemporary Nepali ghazals put images to work.
